name: Osawari Chikan Ressha
source:
The main character is a white-collar worker. One day, when he is on a crowded train, a girl next to him suddenly cries out, "What are you doing!?" He doesn't know what's going on, but he is taken to a station office. He is treated as if he is a criminal even though he tries to prove his innocence. Several hours later, he is somehow released and goes to his office. However, everybody knows what's happened to him and he finally gets fired.... When he is at a loss what to do on the street, an old man taps his shoulder and tells him that it was him who did train molestation on the train. He gets mad at first, but he soon realizes blaming him makes no difference. The man says, "I'm really sorry. However, why don't you take revenge on them...?" When he hears it, something flashes inside his head....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081030025203/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011576]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主角是個上班族。一天，在擠得水洩不通的電車上，身旁一個女孩突然喊道：「你在幹嘛？！」他還沒弄清怎麼回事，就被帶進了站務室。任他怎麼解釋，大家都把他當成了犯人。幾個鐘頭後，他總算脫身趕到公司，才發現事情早已傳開，連工作也丟了……

他茫然地站在街上，一個老人拍了拍他的肩，坦白剛才在車上猥褻那女孩的人正是自己。主角火冒三丈，轉念又明白，怪這老頭也於事無補。老人說：「我真的很對不起你。不過，你就不想找他們報仇嗎……？」聽到這句話，他腦中忽然閃過一個念頭……
